Title: UmbraDesktop Accessories
Description: The small tools for UmbraDesktop. An optional add-on that puts Notepad, Paint, Sticky Notes, Calculator, Clock and a screen saver on the desktop, each in a window of its own and themed along with the rest of it.

AuthorDetails.Name: Luuk Peters
AuthorDetails.Description: Umbraco developer building packages that extend the CMS with enterprise-grade features.

RelatedPackages.Description: The desktop itself. This package is an add-on to it and installs it as a dependency; the desktop works on its own without the accessories.
Games for the desktop, starting with Minesweeper. Independent of this package: install either, both or neither.
